title: Rehabilitation after spine surgery
what: After spine surgery you are taught to move correctly, and your back muscles are slowly strengthened. A rehabilitation specialist leads the sessions.
why: After removal of a disc hernia, fixing of vertebrae and other spine operations.
duration: a session usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; recovery takes from a few weeks to months
tell_doctor: What operation was done and what the surgeon allowed
Whether you need to wear a brace
Whether pain, numbness or weakness in the legs remains

prepare.title: Limits
prepare.text: Ask the surgeon what is not allowed yet: sitting for long, bending, lifting heavy things.

prepare.title: Brace
prepare.text: If a brace was prescribed, bring it to the sessions.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes and shoes that are easy to put on without bending.

steps: The specialist checks movement, strength and sensation
You learn to get out of bed by rolling to the side and to sit down without jerking
Gentle exercises for the belly and back muscles
You learn to pick things up from the floor without bending your back
feel: Your back may ache after sessions
Numbness or tingling in the leg may fade gradually
In the first weeks you tire quickly
after: Do the exercises at home every day
Follow the surgeon's limits on bending and weight
Walk a little but often. It is good for your back
Heavy work and sports only with your doctor's permission
red_flags: Growing weakness or numbness in the legs: call your doctor
Numbness in the groin, or you cannot hold urine or stool: call your local emergency number
Fever above 38, or the wound is red or leaking

faq.q: When can I sit after surgery?
faq.a: It depends on the operation. Sometimes sitting is allowed right away, sometimes it is limited for a few weeks. The surgeon will say.

faq.q: Can I do exercises from the internet?
faq.a: Better not. Exercises are chosen for your operation, and extra ones can do harm.

reminders.text: Back rehabilitation session today. Bring your brace if prescribed and comfortable shoes.
